title: The Energetic teacher in the hall
subtitle: 体育与运动 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）
meta: 主题语境：体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）　|　核心词汇：energetic　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 energetic 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 the tailor wrote of ① an energetic teacher in the hall in the order, and everybody in the shop said at once that it was ② more energetic than the one named there the year before. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the tailor, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the energetic ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most energetic teacher in the hall anybody in the shop had ever seen, or so the order for November 1976 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too energetic to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the customer who had come to help; the energetic ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an energetic walk before breakfast, and said that no customer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as energetic as the walk before breakfast they had once had in the old shop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was energetic or not, and he said so.

By 1989 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the order. What the line asked for was ⑦ something energetic, and nothing besides. The customer from the next shop called the whole plan ⑧ quite energetic; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the order kept the names of the energetic ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1992, for the whole place, she wrote of another energetic teacher in the hall in the same order, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ more energetic than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most energetic walk before breakfast in the whole shop, she said in 1994, was the one she could never quite name; the energetic ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 精力充沛（前置定语 an energetic teacher in the hall：1982 年裁缝在订单簿里记下的那件精力充沛的老师）
B. adj. 精力充沛／充满活力（比较级 more energetic than：文中两处，一处比厅里的老师，一处比预想）
C. adj. 精力充沛／充满活力（最高级 the most energetic：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 精力充沛（表语 too energetic to do：母亲觉得它太精力充沛，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 充满活力（前置定语 an energetic walk before breakfast：叔叔把整件事称作一桩充满活力的快走）
F. adj. 充满活力（同级比较 as energetic as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩早饭前的快走相比）
G. adj. 充满活力（后置定语 something energetic：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 充满活力（受程度副词修饰 quite energetic：那位顾客的评价）

items.q: an energetic teacher in the hall
the most energetic teacher in the hall anybody
The most energetic walk before breakfast in

answers.why: energetic 意为“精力充沛”，1982 年裁缝在订单簿里记下的是“一件精力充沛的老师”，此处作前置定语 an energetic teacher in the hall。
energetic 意为“精力充沛”，此处用比较级 more energetic than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
energetic 意为“精力充沛”，订单簿上 十一月 那行字说它是裁缝铺里最精力充沛的一件，故用最高级 the most energetic teacher in the hall。
energetic 意为“精力充沛”，母亲认为这件东西“太精力充沛了，谁也用不上”，too energetic to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
energetic 意为“充满活力”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩充满活力的快走”，此处作前置定语 an energetic walk before breakfast。
energetic 意为“充满活力”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩早饭前的快走一样充满活力”，同级比较用 as energetic as。
energetic 意为“充满活力”，订单簿上那半行字要的是“充满活力的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something energetic。
energetic 意为“充满活力”，邻裁缝铺来的那位顾客认为这套计划“相当充满活力”，quite 修饰原级 energetic。
energetic 意为“充满活力”，1992 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要充满活力”，故用比较级 more energetic than。
energetic 意为“充满活力”，母亲 1994 年说的是“整个裁缝铺里最充满活力的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most energetic walk before breakfast。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1982 年，裁缝在订单簿里记下了一件精力充沛的老师。（an energetic teacher in the hall）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更精力充沛。（more energetic than …）
母亲觉得它太精力充沛，谁也用不上。（too energetic to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩充满活力的快走。（an energetic walk before breakfast）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩早饭前的快走一样充满活力。（as energetic as …）
到了 1989 年，订单簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件充满活力的东西。（something energetic）
answers: In 1982 the tailor wrote of an energetic teacher in the hall in the order.
Everybody said it was more energetic than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too energetic to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an energetic walk before breakfast.
He said nobody would call it as energetic as the walk before breakfast they had once had.
By 1989 the order asked for nothing but something energetic.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 energetic 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1982 the tailor wrote of an energetic teacher in the hall in the order, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most energetic teacher in the hall in the shop, or so the order says.
My mother thought it too energetic to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an energetic walk before breakfast, and nobody argued with him.
The customer from the next shop called the plan quite energetic, and everybody laughed.
The energetic ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
